groups.label: AAS / IDTA
groups.description: Asset Administration Shell structure, IDTA and DPP4.0, with a CIRPASS-2 report that examines AAS/RDF approaches. The standard has international scope; IDTA's German base is a separate geographic association.

groups.label: W3C — global
groups.description: W3C Verifiable Credentials, DIDs and the DPP & Business Wallet Task Force. Published Recommendations and provisional vocabulary work retain their distinct release statuses.

groups.label: CEN-CENELEC / JTC 24
groups.description: European horizontal DPP standards, the JTC 24 committee and the recorded EU citation decision. Standard publication, Official Journal citation and legal application are separate matters.

groups.label: ISO/IEC JTC 5 — global
groups.description: International DPP committee and the two AWI 25534 work items recorded in release 0.1.0. Work items are not represented as completed standards.

groups.label: China / SAC SWG 41
groups.description: China's DPP working group and General requirements standardisation project. This filter identifies standards activity; it does not convert that activity into a product obligation.

groups.label: GS1
groups.description: GS1 Digital Link and EPCIS versions recorded in the research seed, covering identifiers and event exchange.

groups.label: ITU-T
groups.description: ITU-T Recommendations L.1070 and L.1071, retaining each publication's scope and date.

groups.label: OPC Foundation
groups.description: OPC Foundation and its DPP Information Model specification. The recorded cooperation with Catena-X does not by itself demonstrate cross-system interoperability.

groups.label: Semantic dictionaries
groups.description: IEC CDD, ECLASS, ETIM, buildingSMART bSDD and DPP dictionary-referencing work. This is a comparison group of distinct resources, not a shared governance body or an equivalence claim.

groups.label: UNECE / UN/CEFACT
groups.description: UNECE Recommendation 49 and the UN/CEFACT P1143 business-requirements work item. These remain distinct from the UNTP implementation specifications.

groups.label: CIRPASS-2
groups.description: CIRPASS-2 programme, architecture, exploratory ontology, AAS/RDF report and test environment. Programme geography does not locate every pilot.

groups.label: Global Battery Alliance
groups.description: GBA battery passport programme, reported 2026 trials and planned certification scheme. This voluntary ecosystem is separate from legal battery-passport duties.

groups.label: UNTP
groups.description: UN Transparency Protocol initiative and versioned passport, conformity, identity and traceability specifications. Pilot and working versions retain the maturity recorded in release 0.1.0.

groups.label: RAIN RFID
groups.description: RAIN's DPP identifier-encoding guidance. The seed contains one guidance record, not a complete inventory of RAIN members, deployments or certifications.

groups.label: Battery Pass / BatteryPass-Ready
groups.description: Battery Pass and BatteryPass-Ready projects, their data models and test environment, and DIN DKE SPEC 99100. Testing infrastructure is distinct from evidence that every implementation passes.

groups.label: Catena-X
groups.description: Catena-X, its CX-0143 DPP specification and the reported Japan carbon-footprint exchange demonstration. The demonstration is shared with the Ouranos navigation group and remains bounded to its reported operation.

groups.label: WE BUILD
groups.description: European business-wallet pilot and its architecture blueprint, including the DPP exchange use case. Pilot and simulated components do not establish legal recognition or general production readiness.

groups.label: Ouranos / Japan battery platform
groups.description: Japan's Ouranos programme, Battery Traceability Platform and reported Catena-X carbon-footprint demonstration. Other Japanese pilots are not automatically members of this group.

groups.label: IDTA DPP4.0
groups.description: AAS-based DPP initiative and its supporting association. A separate standards filter exposes the AAS structure and comparative work.

groups.label: Manufacturing-X
groups.description: German industrial-dataspace programme adjacent to DPP implementation. This is a programme-level record, not a claim that all constituent projects implement a DPP.

geographic_associations.note: IDTA's own DPP4.0 page gives its Frankfurt am Main address. This additional association locates the organisation's base; the release's global technical scope is retained and no German legal obligation or exclusive national scope is inferred.

geographic_associations.note: Research navigation association with Germany through the Frankfurt-based IDTA that presents DPP4.0. It is not a deployment-location inventory, domestic mandate or limitation of the initiative's international technical scope.
